messages.author: dadc1b2705a3e4ae
messages.subject: drop groups unused levels
parts:
Hello,

I have the following data set:

foo <-
structure(list(study = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L,
2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 1L, 1L,
1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("study1", "study2", "study3"
), class = "factor"), var = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L,
1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 3L, 2L,
2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L), .Label = c("age", "hist", "meno"
), class = "factor"), cat = structure(c(1L, 2L, 6L, 8L, 10L,
1L, 2L, 6L, 8L, 10L, 3L, 4L, 5L, 7L, 9L, 15L, 14L, 15L, 14L,
15L, 14L, 11L, 12L, 13L, 11L, 12L, 13L, 11L, 12L, 13L), .Label =
c("20-35",
"36-50", "<40", "40-49", "50-59", "51-65", "60-69", "66-75",
">=70", ">76", "ductal", "lobular", "other", "post", "pre"), class =
"factor"),
delta = c(3.6, -0.2, 0.9, 2.1, 2.4, 3.27, 5.33, 4.02, 1.17,
3.11, 4.2, -2, -1.3, 0.6, 3.4, 1.7, -1, 3.15, 1.6, NA, NA,
0, -2.9, -1.9, 3.28, 6.11, 4.69, 1.4, -2.9, NA)), .Names =
c("study",
"var", "cat", "delta"), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA,
-30L))

I want to make a kind of forest plot:

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(foo, aes(x = delta, y = cat, group = cat, colour =
study))
p + geom_point() +
facet_grid(var ~ .)

The resulting plot is not exactly what I want: how can I drop unused
level of the "cat" variable inside each "var" facet?

Thank you very much for you help.

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: drop groups unused levels
parts:
Hi:

You're close:

p + geom_point() + facet_grid(var ~ ., scales = 'free_y')

Is that what you're after?

HTH,
Dennis
